description: Look up one hexadecimal Unicode scalar in official UTS #39 confusables. Returns direct mapped/unmapped status and target sequence; accepts no personal text and makes no identifier-safety judgment. Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call on Base. Requires an x402-capable wallet client.

unicodeVersion.description: Published Unicode security-data version or latest; response identifies actual version.
